## Permitted observations

Please report only non-destructive observations made on stock firmware:

- MTD partition table
- boot log
- network-interface topology
- GPIO/LED/button behavior

## Required context

- Hardware revision and stock firmware version
- Exact observation method and unedited relevant text/photos with secrets removed
- What was observed versus what is inferred

## Safety boundary

Do not flash, reboot for us, erase/write partitions, export full MTD/EEPROM/calibration dumps,
or share MAC addresses, serial numbers, credentials, keys, cookies, or private label photos.
This issue is evidence only: it does not authorize image assembly, calibration replacement, or RF transmission.
